incident_summary: Finance IAM access key used from a foreign IP to enumerate and read S3.
root_cause: Access key leaked via infostealer on employee laptop; STS session reused after key rotation.
outcome: Contained after second detection; ~40 minutes of continued access due to un-revoked STS tokens.
lessons_learned: Rotating keys without invalidating STS tokens left the attacker active. Always revoke STS sessions and notify the Identity team.
